Name: Reckless Swing
Description: Discard a random card. Deal (125% ATK) damage

Name: Blunt End
Description: Blackjack: Play me. Deal (10% ATK) damage and draw 1.

Name: Sleight of Hand
Description: Discard a card at random, then draw 2.

Name: Oops!
Description: Fold: Play me. Deal (75% ATK) damage.

Name: I'm Out
Description: Discard your hand. Gain (20% DEF) block per card discarded.

Name: Stack Your Chips
Description: When you discard a card this turn, deal (10% ATK) damage. Gain 1 AP.

Name: Breakneck Barrage
Description: Discard a card, then deal (50% ATK + Discarded Card's ATK) damage.
Blackjack: Gain ATK+ 1. Deal (80% ATK) damage.

Name: Stack Deck
Description: Draw 2 cards, then put a card on top of your deck.
Blackjack: Gain (90% DEF) block. Deal (90% ATK) damage.

Name: Card Count
Description: Blackjack: Gain (150% DEF) block and put me in your hand. Put this card third from the top of your deck.

Name: Ace in the Hole
Description: Blackjack: Play me. Play the top card of your deck as if you played it from your hand.

Name: Charlie
Description: Draw cards until the top card of your deck has Blackjack.
Consume all Heat. Forge X where X is the amount of Heat consumed.
